headlines.title: 34% Upside for DoorDash? MoffettNathanson Thinks So, and Here’s How
headlines.summary: Key TakeawaysMoffettNathanson cut its DoorDash price target to $239 from $277 on Nov. 11 and kept its Buy rating, a target 34% above the current price.

headlines.title: DoorDash-Instacart combination shines a spotlight on e-commerce pricing
headlines.summary: Their proposed deal places newfound emphasis on how to make online grocery shopping more affordable for shoppers and economically viable for retailers.

headlines.title: DoorDash (DASH) Stock Looks Overvalued Following Its 90% Three Year Run
headlines.summary: DoorDash is back in the spotlight after a mixed run in the share price and a headline acquisition plan. The live question is whether the current valuation can be justified by what the company earns today versus what it might earn in the future. Over the past 3 years, DoorDash shares have gained about 90.1%, which puts a lot of weight on the idea that the business can grow into the expectations now embedded in its valuation.

headlines.title: Uber Becomes McDonald’s “Preferred Delivery Partner” in 14 Markets as Its DoorDash Fight Widens
headlines.summary: Key TakeawaysMcDonald’s named Uber the preferred delivery partner for orders placed in its own app, as part of a multi-year expansion across 14 markets for a McDelivery business that brings in more than $20 billion a year. The deal comes days after another big-brand delivery deal, so Uber has now signed two of the biggest consumer brands while DoorDash works through its deal to buy Instacart.

headlines.title: DoorDash (DASH) Is Growing Fast, but Its $17 Billion Instacart Deal Takes Center Stage
headlines.summary: We just published our list of the 10 Best US Stocks to Invest In for Long Term and DoorDash, Inc. (NASDAQ:DASH) ranked 10th on this list. Recent economic and corporate developments have highlighted the importance of identifying businesses with durable growth opportunities.

description: DoorDash, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, operates a commerce platform that connects merchants, consumers, and dashers in the United States and internationally. The company operates DoorDash Marketplace, Wolt Marketplace, and Deliveroo Marketplace, which provide various services, such as customer acquisition, demand generation, order fulfillment, merchandising, payment processing, and customer support. It also offers consumer membership programs, DashPass, Wolt+, and Deliveroo Plus; advertising as a value-added service through its marketplaces; and white-label delivery fulfillment services, as well as services that help merchants establish online ordering, build branded mobile apps, manage reservations and in-store dining, manage consumer relationships, enable tableside order and pay, and improve customer support. The company was formerly known as Palo Alto Delivery Inc. and changed its name to DoorDash, Inc. in 2015. DoorDash, Inc. was founded in 2013 and is headquartered in San Francisco, California.
